searchText: **schroedingerscode** Hey folks, I'm a bit unsure why we add one to the `DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_TREE_DEPTH` during `verify_merkle_branch` in `process_deposit`. The comment says an additional elem is added to the list to handle the SSZ length mixin, but the best I can tell, deposit proofs are stored in a vector, which is neither serialized nor tree hashed with a length mixin. Update: it would appear as though the vector is sized as DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_TREE_DEPTH+1 in the Deposit class anyway, which is slightly perplexing to me, but I'm gonna blame it being late on a Friday night. The deposit root is the root of an ssz list rather than vector. It has a length mixed in which adds one to the depth you get jjst from a pure merkle tree of the deposit data **schroedingerscode** Thanks. Totally missed this part: `deposit_data_list = List[DepositData, 2**DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_TREE_DEPTH](*leaves[:index + 1])` Makes sense now. No worries! We decided to make the contract deposit root a valid ssz root to avoid having a separate merkle tree construction for this one thing (as it was before) <@539495253418180618> > but it avoids having more special casing in the phase 0 spec that we will all have to maintain in perpetuity what casing are you referring to? having to do ad-hoc things to juggle the fact that we don't have proper values for e.g. the justified and finalized checkpoint in the early epochs I might be missing something but isn't `Checkpoint(epoch = 0, root = signing_root(genesis_block))` a valid finalized and justified checkpoint for genesis state? it is but the genesis state has `finalized_checkpoint == Checkpoint(0, 0x0)` it isn't updated until a few epochs have played out and validators have justified some of the early stuff Right. But what is the obstacle to passing `genesis_block_root` into genesis initialisation to have `finalized_checkpoint == Checkpoint(0, genesis_block_root) ` in the genesis state? Circular dependency the genesis_block contains the genesis state root So we could potentially clean it up in the first slot transition after genesis but that was pretty ugly instead, opted for Checkpoint(0, 0) == GenesisCheckpoint locally got it! this dependency is the thing that I missed, thanks for clarification

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**schroedingerscode**
Hey folks, I'm a bit unsure why we add one to the `DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_TREE_DEPTH` during `verify_merkle_branch` in `process_deposit`. The comment says an additional elem is added to the list to handle the SSZ length mixin, but the best I can tell, deposit proofs are stored in a vector, which is neither serialized nor tree hashed with a length mixin.

Update: it would appear as though the vector is sized as DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_TREE_DEPTH+1 in the Deposit class anyway, which is slightly perplexing to me, but I'm gonna blame it being late on a Friday night.

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: The deposit root is the root of an ssz list rather than vector. It has a length mixed in which adds one to the depth you get jjst from a pure merkle tree of the deposit data

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**schroedingerscode**
Thanks. Totally missed this part: `deposit_data_list = List[DepositData, 2**DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_TREE_DEPTH](*leaves[:index + 1])`

Makes sense now.

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: No worries! We decided to make the contract deposit root a valid ssz root to avoid having a separate merkle tree construction for this one thing (as it was before)

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: I might be missing something but isn't `Checkpoint(epoch = 0, root = signing_root(genesis_block))` a valid finalized and justified checkpoint for genesis state?

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: but the genesis state has `finalized_checkpoint == Checkpoint(0, 0x0)`

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: it isn't updated until a few epochs have played out and validators have justified some of the early stuff

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: Right. But what is the obstacle to passing `genesis_block_root` into genesis initialisation to have `finalized_checkpoint == Checkpoint(0, genesis_block_root) ` in the genesis state?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: the genesis_block contains the genesis state root

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: So we could potentially clean it up in the first slot transition after genesis but that was pretty ugly

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: instead, opted for Checkpoint(0, 0) == GenesisCheckpoint locally
